    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "100% Crit Chance, 0% Survival Rate",
      "goal": "Artie awakens in the world of Aethelgard with a glitched Luck stat that guarantees critical hits but locks his HP at 1.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From a confused casualty of reality to a high-stakes gambler where any damage is permadeath.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Artie's mundane life ends in a freak server-room accident.",
        "to_next": "Artie must find a way to kill the Tutorial Guardian without taking a single point of chip damage."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 3,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Server Room Incident",
          "intent": "Establish Artie's mundane life and the catalyst for his transition to Aethelgard.",
          "end_condition": "Artie is electrocuted during a server-room surge and loses consciousness.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie performs routine maintenance on a high-density server rack.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies a critical power fluctuation in the main server rack.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Global Data Solutions - Server Hub 4",
              "location_end_label": "Global Data Solutions - Server Hub 4",
              "location_start": "LOC_SERVER_ROOM",
              "location_end": "LOC_SERVER_ROOM",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The hum of cooling fans fills the narrow aisle as Artie checks the diagnostic monitor in Server Hub 4.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blinking server LEDs", "cold air intake", "tangled ethernet cables"],
              "transition_out_text": "The diagnostic monitor begins to flicker with strange, unreadable symbols as the power grid fluctuates.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flickering screen", "burnt plastic smell", "static discharge"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "The server rack explodes in a surge of blue electricity, striking Artie.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Artie is knocked unconscious by the electrical surge.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Global Data Solutions - Server Hub 4",
              "location_end_label": "Global Data Solutions - Server Hub 4",
              "location_start": "LOC_SERVER_ROOM",
              "location_end": "LOC_SERVER_ROOM",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "transition_in_text": "The smell of ozone thickens as the server rack begins to vibrate violently against the floor bolts.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["ozone smell", "arcing electricity", "shattered monitor glass"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "transition_out_text": "The world goes white as a massive surge of power blasts through Artie's chest.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blinding white light", "high-pitched whine", "numbing sensation"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie is electrocuted during a server-room surge and loses consciousness."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Glass Cannon Awakening",
          "intent": "Introduce the glitched status and the immediate danger of the 1 HP constraint.",
          "end_condition": "Artie confirms his stats show 100% Critical Hit Chance and exactly 1/1 HP.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie awakens in a digital void and is forced to initialize a character.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the world of Aethelgard with a glitched character sheet.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "The Void Space",
              "location_end_label": "The Void Space",
              "location_start": "LOC_VOID",
              "location_end": "LOC_VOID",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie awakens in a place where gravity feels like a suggestion rather than a law.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["weightless sensation", "scrolling green text", "distant digital hum"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "transition_out_text": "A floating window appears before Artie, demanding he initialize his character.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blue UI window", "pulsing cursor", "virtual keyboard"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie attempts to distribute his stat points but the System freezes.",
              "type": "conflict",
              "outcome": "A system error locks Artie's HP at 1 and his Luck at an impossible value.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "The Void Space",
              "location_end_label": "The Void Space",
              "location_start": "LOC_VOID",
              "location_end": "LOC_VOID",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "processed",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie taps the virtual interface, but the numbers begin to spin uncontrollably like a broken slot machine.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["spinning stat counters", "red error glow", "distorted system audio"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "transition_out_text": "The initialization sequence finishes with a sharp chime that sounds more like a warning.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["finalized stat block", "gold notification border", "vanishing void walls"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie spawns in the tutorial zone and inspects his finalized stats.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes his character is a permanent glass cannon.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Spawn Point",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Spawn Point",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_SPAWN",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_SPAWN",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie's boots hit solid stone as the digital void dissolves into a sun-drenched courtyard.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["warm sunlight", "rough stone paving", "scent of pine needles"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "transition_out_text": "The reality of his 1 HP status sinks in as a nearby butterfly deals 0.1 damage to a flower.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["floating health bar", "crimson 1/1 text", "shaking hands"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie confirms his stats show 100% Critical Hit Chance and exactly 1/1 HP."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Tutorial Guardian",
          "intent": "Demonstrate the 'Hit & Run' combat style against the first major threat.",
          "end_condition": "The Tutorial Guardian is defeated without Artie taking a single point of damage.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "The Tutorial Guardian blocks the exit and initiates combat.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie enters his first life-or-death battle.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_GUARDIAN"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_GUARDIAN"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "A massive stone golem rumbles to life at the far end of the arena, its eyes glowing with a hostile blue light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["grinding stone", "dust clouds", "heavy metallic footsteps"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "The Guardian raises a massive fist, and Artie realizes he has nowhere to hide.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["shadow of the fist", "cracking ground", "battle music swell"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie discovers that every hit he lands is a massive critical strike.",
              "type": "conflict",
              "outcome": "Artie learns to kite the Guardian while dealing massive damage.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_GUARDIAN"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie lunges forward with his starter dagger, the blade catching a sliver of light as it strikes the golem's knee.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["golden critical sparks", "shattering stone", "staggering golem"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "The Guardian roars in frustration, swinging wildly as Artie dances just out of reach.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["whistling stone fist", "sweat on the brow", "panting breath"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie delivers the final blow to the Guardian, shattering it.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "The Guardian is defeated, and Artie earns a 'No-Hit' bonus.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_GUARDIAN"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Arena",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_ARENA",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_ARENA",
              "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The Tutorial Guardian lunges forward, its stone fist whistling through the air where Artie stood a second ago.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["cracked stone floor", "whistling wind", "glowing blue runes"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "end_condition_echo": "The Tutorial Guardian is defeated without Artie taking a single point of damage."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "The Tutorial is a Speedrun",
      "goal": "Exploit the 'Perfect Dodge' mechanic to clear the starter zone in record time and trigger a hidden achievement.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "Acquiring legendary-tier starter gear makes Artie a target for envious high-level players early on.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Artie survives the initial spawn and realizes the System rewards 'No-Hit' runs.",
        "to_next": "The achievement grants Artie a map to a forgotten dungeon that requires high movement speed."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Mastering the Perfect Dodge",
          "intent": "Artie exploits the game's i-frame mechanics to survive low-level mob aggro.",
          "end_condition": "Artie successfully chains ten 'Perfect Dodges' in a single encounter.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie enters the Whispering Woods and encounters a pack of Shadow Wolves.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie decides to use the wolves to practice his timing.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "location_end": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie steps out of the tutorial boss arena and into the sunlight of the Whispering Woods.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["rustling leaves", "howling shadows", "snapping twigs"],
              "transition_out_text": "Three pairs of glowing yellow eyes emerge from the thicket, locking onto Artie's fragile frame.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["low growls", "bared fangs", "tightened grip"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie begins kiting the wolves, focusing on the visual cues for their attacks.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes the 'Perfect Dodge' grants a brief moment of invulnerability.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "location_end": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The first wolf leaps, a blur of grey fur and sharp teeth aimed directly at Artie's throat.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blur of motion", "clashing teeth", "silver dodge trail"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "transition_out_text": "The wolf's claws pass through Artie as if he were made of smoke, triggering a system chime.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["blue after-image", "slow-motion effect", "adrenaline surge"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie intentionally pulls more wolves to maximize his dodge chain.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Artie masters the timing required for the next stage of his plan.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_start": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "location_end": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The pack surrounds Artie, their attacks coming in a rhythmic sequence that he begins to predict.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["circling shadows", "synchronized lunges", "perfect dodge counter"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "transition_out_text": "With the tenth dodge, the wolves' movement slows to a crawl, leaving them wide open.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["frozen wolves", "sparking dagger", "triumphant smirk"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie successfully chains ten 'Perfect Dodges' in a single encounter."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Speedrunner's Shortcut",
          "intent": "Artie uses his knowledge of game geometry to bypass standard tutorial gates.",
          "end_condition": "Artie reaches the hidden 'Developer's Backdoor' in the starter zone.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie locates a specific rock formation that allows for 'wall-clipping'.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie finds the entry point for the exploit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Whispering Woods",
              "location_end_label": "The Jagged Ridge",
              "location_start": "LOC_WHISPERING_WOODS",
              "location_end": "LOC_JAGGED_RIDGE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie leaves the woods behind, climbing toward the sheer cliffs that mark the edge of the playable map.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["loose gravel", "sheer rock face", "glitched texture seam"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "transition_out_text": "He spots the corner where two textures overlap, creating a gap just large enough for a player model.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flickering shadows", "invisible ledge", "system warning"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie performs a series of precise jumps to bypass the invisible walls.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie successfully 'clips' through the environment.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "The Jagged Ridge",
              "location_end_label": "The Grey Void Edge",
              "location_start": "LOC_JAGGED_RIDGE",
              "location_end": "LOC_VOID_EDGE",
              "handoff_mode": "hard_cut",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie takes a leap of faith into the flickering corner, his body momentarily stretching into a wireframe mesh.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["wireframe view", "missing textures", "wind sound loop"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "transition_out_text": "He lands on a narrow strip of land that shouldn't exist, overlooking the back of the world.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["unrendered trees", "flat horizon", "echoing silence"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie navigates the 'out-of-bounds' area to reach the shortcut.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie avoids the automated 'out-of-bounds' reset triggers.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH", "THREAD_ANTI_CHEAT"],
              "location_start_label": "The Grey Void Edge",
              "location_end_label": "The Grey Void Edge",
              "location_start": "LOC_VOID_EDGE",
              "location_end": "LOC_VOID_EDGE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "pursued",
              "transition_in_text": "Red 'Warning' text begins to scroll across Artie's vision as the System attempts to locate his position.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["scrolling red text", "pulsing alarm", "static interference"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "transition_out_text": "He sprints along the edge of the abyss, his footsteps making no sound on the untextured ground.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["black pit", "floating assets", "rapid heartbeat"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie finds the 'Developer's Backdoor'—a simple wooden door in the middle of nowhere.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the hidden developer area.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "The Grey Void Edge",
              "location_end_label": "Developer's Backdoor",
              "location_start": "LOC_VOID_EDGE",
              "location_end": "LOC_BACKDOOR",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "sheltered",
              "transition_in_text": "In the distance, a single, perfectly rendered oak door stands upright without a frame or a wall.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["polished brass knob", "grainy wood texture", "soft golden glow"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie reaches for the handle, the System alarms suddenly cutting out as he touches the wood.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["abrupt silence", "cool brass", "opening door"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie reaches the hidden 'Developer's Backdoor' in the starter zone."
            }
          ]
        },

          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Hidden Achievement",
          "intent": "Secure the legendary-tier starter gear through a 'No-Hit' clear achievement.",
          "end_condition": "The System grants the 'Untouchable Legend' title and the associated gear set.",

              "outcome": "Artie accesses the achievement log.",

              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],

              "location_start_label": "The Debug Room",
              "location_end_label": "The Debug Room",

    {
      "chapter_id": 3,
      "title": "Glass Cannon in a Stone World",
      "goal": "Cross the treacherous Iron Peaks to reach the trade hub of Oakhaven before his 'Newbie Protection' buff expires.",
      "chapter_role": "journey",
      "stakes_shift": "Environmental hazards introduce threats that cannot be 'critically hit' or easily dodged.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Artie leaves the tutorial zone with a unique title and a massive target on his back.",
        "to_next": "Artie arrives at Oakhaven only to find the gates barred to anyone without a guild voucher."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "slow_burn",
        "expected_scene_count": 9
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Into the Iron Peaks",
          "intent": "Transition from the safe tutorial zone to the high-stakes open world.",
          "end_condition": "Artie crosses the threshold into the Iron Peaks territory.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie travels to the edge of the starter zone.",
